pin.longFormSummary:
A budget hybrid hotel near Fira Gran Via in L’Hospitalet de Llobregat, with private family rooms and a shared microwave, fridge and kettle area.

Family and budget stay

The operator describes this property as exclusively private rooms, including family configurations for up to four guests. Confirm your selected bed layout and cot requirements. Its communal Heat & Eat area lists microwaves, a fridge and a kettle; check the equipment you need before relying on self-catering.

The hotel is in the Fira Gran Via exhibition district rather than the historic centre. Allow transit time to central Barcelona and compare the actual room total for your dates, including tax, breakfast, parking and other extras.

Review tradeoffs

The opened Tripadvisor snapshot is a small early sample of nine reviews, with a 3.2/5 overall rating. Published service and cleanliness components are 3.2 and 3.4/5. Read recent reviews about those points and basic in-room amenities before booking; these are dated research snapshots, not live scores.

Opening and investment

The hotel opened on 25 June 2026 with 162 rooms. The operator reports nearly €4 million spent on furniture, fixtures and equipment. That is a limited fit-out component, not a complete property development budget; no whole-project cost is assigned.

pin.longFormSummary:
A LEGO-themed family hotel at Dubai Parks and Resorts, with dedicated children’s sleeping areas, in-room treasure hunts, a lobby play area and a hotel pool.

Family stay

The current hotel page lists themed, fully themed and accessible rooms for up to five guests, with a dedicated children’s sleeping area in the same room. Two-bedroom family suites with a living room are listed for up to eight. Check the exact room category, bed configuration and occupancy for your household.

The hotel is at Dubai Parks and Resorts in the Jebel Ali area, suited to a park-focused visit. Plan transport separately for central Dubai sights. Compare package totals and check exactly which park tickets, breakfast, fees and extras are included.

The National’s March 2022 hosted family stay describes an imaginative themed room and treasure hunt. It is a historical firsthand review: its old rates, pandemic-era practices and inclusions are not current booking promises.

Check current park operating hours, ride availability and height restrictions for the dates you choose. The operator maintains a separate operational-updates page.

Opening

The 250-room hotel welcomed overnight guests on 21 January 2022. This hotel milestone is separate from the theme park opening.
